sql:
SELECT s.session_id,s.login_time,s.login_name,DB_NAME(s.database_id) db_name,s.transaction_isolation_level,s.open_transaction_count,
  (SELECT c.connection_id FROM sys.dm_exec_connections c WHERE c.session_id=s.session_id AND c.parent_connection_id IS NULL) connection_id
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions s WHERE s.session_id=@sid AND s.login_time=@login_time AND s.login_name=@login
AND @@SERVERNAME=@server;
SELECT r.* FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON r.session_id=s.session_id WHERE s.session_id=@sid AND s.login_time=@login_time AND s.login_name=@login
AND @@SERVERNAME=@server;
SELECT l.* FROM sys.dm_tran_locks l JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON l.request_session_id=s.session_id WHERE s.session_id=@sid AND s.login_time=@login_time AND s.login_name=@login
AND @@SERVERNAME=@server;
SELECT x.* FROM sys.dm_tran_active_snapshot_database_transactions x JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON x.session_id=s.session_id WHERE s.session_id=@sid AND s.login_time=@login_time AND s.login_name=@login
AND @@SERVERNAME=@server;
SELECT x.*, a.transaction_begin_time,a.transaction_state FROM sys.dm_tran_session_transactions x JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON x.session_id=s.session_id LEFT JOIN sys.dm_tran_active_transactions a ON a.transaction_id=x.transaction_id WHERE s.session_id=@sid AND s.login_time=@login_time AND s.login_name=@login
AND @@SERVERNAME=@server;
SELECT d.name,CONVERT(int,d.is_read_committed_snapshot_on) is_read_committed_snapshot_on,d.snapshot_isolation_state,d.snapshot_isolation_state_desc,
  CONVERT(int,sys.fn_hadr_is_primary_replica(d.name)) is_ag_primary,
  SERVERPROPERTY('IsHadrEnabled') is_hadr_enabled,@@SERVERNAME server_name,
  rs.role_desc,ar.secondary_role_allow_connections_desc,rs.connected_state_desc,
  ds.synchronization_state_desc,ds.synchronization_health_desc,ds.is_suspended,
  ds.redo_queue_size,ds.last_redone_lsn,ds.last_hardened_lsn,ds.last_commit_time,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id=r.session_id
   WHERE s.is_user_process=1 AND r.database_id=d.database_id AND r.command IN
     ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','MERGE','BULK INSERT','SELECT INTO')) active_user_writes
FROM sys.databases d
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states ds ON ds.database_id=d.database_id AND ds.is_local=1
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_hadr_availability_replica_states rs ON rs.replica_id=ds.replica_id AND rs.group_id=ds.group_id AND rs.is_local=1
LEFT JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON ar.replica_id=ds.replica_id
WHERE d.database_id=DB_ID();
primary_sql:
SELECT @@SERVERNAME server_name,sys.fn_hadr_is_primary_replica(N'ManualCount100m') is_ag_primary,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id=r.session_id
  WHERE s.is_user_process=1 AND r.database_id=DB_ID(N'ManualCount100m')
    AND r.command IN ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','MERGE','BULK INSERT','SELECT INTO')) active_user_writes,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_tran_database_transactions dt JOIN sys.dm_tran_session_transactions st ON st.transaction_id=dt.transaction_id
  WHERE dt.database_id=DB_ID(N'ManualCount100m') AND st.is_user_transaction=1) active_user_transactions;
SELECT ds.replica_id,ds.synchronization_state_desc,ds.synchronization_health_desc,ds.log_send_queue_size,
 ds.redo_queue_size,ds.is_suspended,ds.last_sent_lsn,ds.last_hardened_lsn,ds.last_redone_lsn,ds.last_commit_time
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states ds
JOIN sys.availability_replicas ar ON ar.replica_id=ds.replica_id
WHERE ds.is_local=0 AND ds.database_id=DB_ID(N'ManualCount100m') AND ar.replica_server_name=N'countsecondary';
